avif_1.wasm.name: avif
avif_1.wasm.help: This filter extracts the primary AV1-coded image item from an AVIF (HEIF/MIAF) file using GPAC's own ISOBMFF meta/item APIs, and pairs with the libaom-based av1dec filter for decoding.

bifsdec_1.wasm.name: bifsdec
bifsdec_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes MPEG-4 BIFS binary frames directly into the scene graph of the compositor.

btplay_1.wasm.name: btplay
btplay_1.wasm.description: MPEG-4 BIFS (BT/XMT), VRML97 and X3D scene loader
btplay_1.wasm.help: This filter loads textual scene descriptions - MPEG-4 BIFS in BT or XMT syntax, VRML97 and X3D - into the compositor's scene graph.

ffmpeg-ffv1_1.wasm.name: ffmpeg-ffv1
ffmpeg-ffv1_1.wasm.help: This is a reduced version of ffmpeg carrying the FFV1 decoder only. FFV1 is a lossless intra-frame video codec used for archiving; its reference implementation is ffmpeg itself.

ffmpeg-flac_1.wasm.name: ffmpeg-flac
ffmpeg-flac_1.wasm.help: This is a reduced version of ffmpeg adapted to decode flac content.

ffmpeg-g726_1.wasm.name: ffmpeg-g726
ffmpeg-g726_1.wasm.help: This is a reduced version of ffmpeg carrying the two G.726 ADPCM decoders only. G.726 above 24 kbit/s is not the same bitstream as Sun's G.721 and G.723, which libg711 reads from .au files.

ffmpeg-h26x_1.wasm.name: ffmpeg-h26x
ffmpeg-h26x_1.wasm.help: This is a reduced version of ffmpeg carrying the H.261 and H.263 decoders only, the two ITU-T video recommendations that predate MPEG-4 AVC and have no free standalone decoder.

ffmpeg-hevc_1.wasm.name: ffmpeg-hevc
ffmpeg-hevc_1.wasm.help: This is a reduced version of ffmpeg adapted to decode hevc content.

ffmpeg-mpeg1_1.wasm.name: ffmpeg-mpeg1
ffmpeg-mpeg1_1.wasm.help: This is a reduced version of ffmpeg adapted to decode mpeg1 contents in a canvas.

ffmpeg-x264_1.wasm.name: ffmpeg-x264
ffmpeg-x264_1.wasm.description: x264 encoder through the ffmpeg wrapper
ffmpeg-x264_1.wasm.help: This is a reduced version of ffmpeg carrying the libx264 encoder only. It encodes raw video to H.264 through GPAC's generic ffmpeg encoder filter, and exists alongside libx264, which drives the same encoder directly.

h264bsd_1.wasm.name: h264bsd
h264bsd_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes H264 CBP streams through h264 bsd library.

isobmff_1.wasm.name: isobmff
isobmff_1.wasm.help: This filter multiplexes and demultiplexes ISOBMF (14496-12 and derived specifications).

libOpenVVC_1.wasm.name: libOpenVVC
libOpenVVC_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes VVC (H.266) video elementary streams using VVdeC. Pairs with a container demuxer (e.g. isobmff) providing framed access units and a VVCC decoder config.

liba52_1.wasm.name: liba52
liba52_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes AC3 streams through a52dec library.

libaiff_1.wasm.name: libaiff
libaiff_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes AIFF/AIFC audio files using libaiff.

libalac_1.wasm.name: libalac
libalac_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes Apple Lossless audio using Apple's reference implementation.

libamr_1.wasm.name: libamr
libamr_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes AMR-NB and AMR-WB speech files using opencore-amr.

libaom_1.wasm.name: libaom
libaom_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes AV1 video elementary streams using libaom. Pairs with a demuxer (e.g. webmdmx) providing framed AV1 temporal units.

libape_1.wasm.name: libape
libape_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes Monkey's Audio (.ape) files using the Monkey's Audio SDK.

libbpg_1.wasm.name: libbpg
libbpg_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes BPG ("Better Portable Graphics") images using libbpg's own bundled HEVC decoder.

libcharls_1.wasm.name: libcharls
libcharls_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes JPEG-LS (ISO/IEC 14495-1) images using CharLS.

libcodec2_1.wasm.name: libcodec2
libcodec2_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes Codec 2 speech files (.c2) using libcodec2. Output is always 8 kHz mono.

libdavs2_1.wasm.name: libdavs2
libdavs2_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes raw AVS2 elementary streams using davs2.

libdca_1.wasm.name: libdca
libdca_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes DTS elementary streams using dcadec, a standalone DTS decoder.

libdds_1.wasm.name: libdds
libdds_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes BC1 to BC7 compressed DDS textures using bcdec.

libde265_1.wasm.name: libde265
libde265_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes HEVC (H.265) video elementary streams using libde265. Pairs with a container demuxer (e.g. isobmff) providing framed access units and an HVCC decoder config.

libdjvu_1.wasm.name: libdjvu
libdjvu_1.wasm.help: This filter renders the first page of a DjVu document to a raw image using DjVuLibre.

libfaad_1.wasm.name: libfaad
libfaad_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes AAC streams through faad library.

libflac_1.wasm.name: libflac
libflac_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes FLAC audio files using libFLAC.

libflif_1.wasm.name: libflif
libflif_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes FLIF (Free Lossless Image Format) images using the FLIF reference decoder.

libg711_1.wasm.name: libg711
libg711_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes Sun/NeXT .au files carrying G.711 mu-law or A-law, or G.721 and G.723 ADPCM, to raw 16-bit PCM.

libgif_1.wasm.name: libgif
libgif_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes GIF images and animations using giflib: every frame is composited onto the canvas and output in turn, with the timing carried by the file.

libgme_1.wasm.name: libgme
libgme_1.wasm.help: This filter renders video game music files (NSF, GBS, SPC, VGM, AY, GYM, HES, KSS, SAP) to PCM by emulating the original sound hardware, using game-music-emu.

libgsm_1.wasm.name: libgsm
libgsm_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes raw GSM 06.10 Full Rate audio (8 kHz mono, 33-byte frames) using libgsm.

libheif_1.wasm.name: libheif
libheif_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes HEIF/HEIC (HEVC-coded) images using libheif. For AVIF (AV1-coded), use the lighter avif;libaom filter pair instead.

libicns_1.wasm.name: libicns
libicns_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes the largest 32-bit icon of an Apple ICNS file using libicns.

libilbc_1.wasm.name: libilbc
libilbc_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes iLBC speech files using libilbc.

libisac_1.wasm.name: libisac
libisac_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes iSAC, the wideband speech codec of WebRTC, from the bitstream dump format of WebRTC's own test program. iSAC was removed from WebRTC in 2022 and has no standalone library; the sources are the last consistent snapshot.

libjbig2_1.wasm.name: libjbig2
libjbig2_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes standalone JBIG2 (ITU-T T.88) bi-level images using jbig2dec.

libjbig_1.wasm.name: libjbig
libjbig_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes JBIG (ITU-T T.82) bi-level images using JBIG-KIT.

libjpeg_1.wasm.name: libjpeg
libjpeg_1.wasm.help: This filter encodes and decodes to JPEG using libjpeg.

libjxl_1.wasm.name: libjxl
libjxl_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes JXL images using libjxl.

libjxr_1.wasm.name: libjxr
libjxr_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes JPEG XR (ITU-T T.832, also known as HD Photo / Windows Media Photo) images using jxrlib.

liblc3_1.wasm.name: liblc3
liblc3_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes LC3 bitstream files, the codec of Bluetooth LE Audio, using Google's liblc3.

libmad_1.wasm.name: libmad
libmad_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes MPEG 1/2 audio streams through libmad library.

libmidi_1.wasm.name: libmidi
libmidi_1.wasm.help: This filter renders Standard MIDI Files (SMF) to PCM audio using TiMidity++ with the bundled freepats GM instrument set.

libmng_1.wasm.name: libmng
libmng_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes MNG animations and JNG images using libmng, sending one frame per packet with the timing carried by the file.

libmp3lame_1.wasm.name: libmp3lame
libmp3lame_1.wasm.help: This filter encodes a raw S16 PCM audio PID to MPEG-1 Layer III (MP3) by calling libmp3lame's native API directly.

libmpc_1.wasm.name: libmpc
libmpc_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes Musepack (.mpc, stream versions 7 and 8) audio using libmpcdec.

libmpeg2_1.wasm.name: libmpeg2
libmpeg2_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes raw MPEG-1/2 video elementary streams using libmpeg2.

libmpg123_1.wasm.name: libmpg123
libmpg123_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes MPEG-1/2 audio (MP3) files using mpg123.

libmupdf_1.wasm.name: libmupdf
libmupdf_1.wasm.description: Document decoder (XPS, CBZ, EPUB, FB2, MOBI)
libmupdf_1.wasm.help: This filter renders the first page of an XPS, CBZ, EPUB, FictionBook or Mobipocket document to a raw image using MuPDF.

libopus_1.wasm.name: libopus
libopus_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes Opus audio using libopus. Use together with the oggdmx filter to demultiplex Ogg Opus files.

libopusenc_1.wasm.name: libopusenc
libopusenc_1.wasm.help: This filter encodes a raw S16 PCM audio PID (48kHz) to Opus by calling libopus's native API directly.

libpgf_1.wasm.name: libpgf
libpgf_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes PGF (Progressive Graphics File) images using libpgf.

libpng_1.wasm.name: libpng
libpng_1.wasm.help: This filter encodes and decodes to PNG using libpng.

libpoppler_1.wasm.name: libpoppler
libpoppler_1.wasm.help: This filter renders the first page of a PDF file to a raw RGB image using poppler.

libpsd_1.wasm.name: libpsd
libpsd_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes the merged image of Photoshop PSD/PSB documents using psd_sdk.

libqoi_1.wasm.name: libqoi
libqoi_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes QOI ("Quite OK Image Format") images using qoi.h.

libraw_1.wasm.name: libraw
libraw_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes camera RAW images (CR2, NEF, ARW, DNG, ORF, RAF, RW2, ...) using LibRaw.

librecoil_1.wasm.name: librecoil
librecoil_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes retro computer picture formats (Amiga IFF/ILBM, Atari ST Degas PI1/PC1, Microsoft Paint MSP, and many others) using RECOIL.

libsbc_1.wasm.name: libsbc
libsbc_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes raw SBC audio, the low-complexity subband codec of Bluetooth A2DP, using libsbc from BlueZ.

libschro_1.wasm.name: libschro
libschro_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes raw Dirac elementary streams using schroedinger.

libsilk_1.wasm.name: libsilk
libsilk_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes standalone SILK speech files using the SILK SDK. This is not the SILK carried inside Opus: the two bitstreams differ by the frame header Opus moved into its TOC byte.

libspeex_1.wasm.name: libspeex
libspeex_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes Speex speech streams using libspeex. It consumes the GF_CODECID_SPEEX pid produced by oggdmx from a .spx file.

libtiff_1.wasm.name: libtiff
libtiff_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes TIFF images using libtiff.

libtta_1.wasm.name: libtta
libtta_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes True Audio (TTA) lossless files using libtta.

libuavs3d_1.wasm.name: libuavs3d
libuavs3d_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes raw AVS3 elementary streams using uavs3d.

libutvideo_1.wasm.name: libutvideo
libutvideo_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes Ut Video, the lossless intra codec found in AVI files.

libvpx_1.wasm.name: libvpx
libvpx_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes VP8/VP9 video elementary streams using libvpx. Pairs with a demuxer (e.g. webmdmx) providing framed VP8/VP9 coded frames.

libwavpack_1.wasm.name: libwavpack
libwavpack_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes WavPack (.wv) audio using libwavpack.

libwebp_1.wasm.name: libwebp
libwebp_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes WebP images (lossy, lossless and alpha) using libwebp.

libx264_1.wasm.name: libx264
libx264_1.wasm.help: This filter encodes a raw YUV420 video PID to H.264/AVC by calling libx264's native API directly, without going through FFmpeg.

libx265_1.wasm.name: libx265
libx265_1.wasm.help: This filter encodes a raw YUV420 video PID to HEVC by calling libx265's native API directly, without going through FFmpeg.

libxcf_1.wasm.name: libxcf
libxcf_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes GIMP XCF documents using the core of xcftools, compositing the visible layers onto the canvas.

libxevd_1.wasm.name: libxevd
libxevd_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes raw EVC elementary streams using xevd.

libxmp_1.wasm.name: libxmp
libxmp_1.wasm.description: Tracker module decoder (MOD, XM, S3M, IT, ...)
libxmp_1.wasm.help: This filter renders tracker modules (Protracker MOD, Fast Tracker XM, Scream Tracker S3M, Impulse Tracker IT and about ninety other formats) to PCM using libxmp.

libxvid_1.wasm.name: libxvid
libxvid_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes MPEG-4 part 2 (and DivX) through libxvidcore library.

ogg_1.wasm.name: oggdmx
ogg_1.wasm.help: This filter demultiplexes OGG files/data into a set of media PIDs and frames.

openjpeg_1.wasm.name: openjpeg
openjpeg_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes JPEG2000 streams through OpenJPEG library.

qdbmp_1.wasm.name: qdbmp
qdbmp_1.wasm.help: QDBMP (Quick n' Dirty BMP) is a minimalistic C library for handling BMP image files.

rfpcm_1.wasm.name: rfpcm
rfpcm_1.wasm.help: This filter parses raw PCM file/data or WAVE files and outputs corresponding raw audio.

rgbyuv_1.wasm.name: rgbyuv
rgbyuv_1.wasm.help: This filter converts packed RGB frames to planar YUV 4:2:0 so that an RGB-producing decoder can feed a video encoder.

simpleimg_1.wasm.name: simpleimg
simpleimg_1.wasm.description: Simple bitmap decoder (PCX, TGA, SGI, PNM, XBM)
simpleimg_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes PCX, Truevision TGA, SGI/RGB, PNM (PBM/PGM/PPM) and X11 XBM images.

theora_1.wasm.name: theora
theora_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes Theora streams through libtheora library.

vorbis_1.wasm.name: vorbis
vorbis_1.wasm.help: This filter decodes Ogg and Vorbis streams through libogg and libvorbis library.

webmdmx_1.wasm.name: webmdmx
webmdmx_1.wasm.help: This filter demultiplexes WebM/Matroska files using nestegg, exposing the AV1/VP8/VP9 video track (if any) for a downstream decoder (libaom for AV1, libvpx for VP8/VP9).
